semantics: Displayed guide prices remain guide prices, not achieved sale prices.
Auction date, address, guide price, property class and tenure are retained from the official dated livestream page.
Publisher descriptions were not converted into legal title, lawful-use, parcel or geometry proof.
Lots 55, 56, 75A, 77, 79A, 83, 84 and 85A were excluded because the official page marks them Withdrawn, Sold Prior or Postponed.
Lots 80A, 86A and 102 were excluded because their locations are outside England.
Nine representative exact-address repository searches returned no prior match for the selected source slice.
Duplicate prevention was bounded to recent waves, current batch and representative exact-address searches; it is not a complete historical title or UPRN scan.
